cases.title: Valid HELLO + CAPABILITIES + samples are accepted
cases.expected: samples queued, no errors, sensors advertised
cases.actual: samples=10 errors=[] sensors=12

cases.title: Python parser rejects an incomplete HELLO envelope (the case A07 says the C firmware accepts)
cases.actual: errors=['Invalid protocol message: ValidationError'] identity=None
cases.notes: Firmware side stays static-review only (NOT TESTED).

cases.title: Malformed protocol input is rejected without crashing the receiver
cases.input: 10 malformed inputs (version, JSON, duplicate key, NaN, missing fields, oversize, order)
cases.expected: each produces an error or no state
cases.actual: {"version 2": [true, ["Unsupported protocol version"]], "version true": [true, ["Unsupported protocol version"]], "invalid JSON": [true, ["Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes: line 1 column 2 (char 1)"]], "duplicate key": [true, ["Duplicate JSON key"]], "NaN constant": [true, ["Nonfinite JSON number: NaN"]], "no payload": [true, ["Invalid protocol message: ValidationError"]], "no device_id": [true, ["Invalid protocol message: ValidationError"]], "missing newline then oversize": [true, ["oversized_line"]], "sample before handshake": [true, ["HELLO is required for this device/session/source"]], "CAPABILITIES without sensors": [true, ["Invalid protocol message: ValidationError"]]}

cases.title: A very large line is dropped and the stream recovers on the next valid message
cases.expected: oversized error then the sample is accepted
cases.actual: errors=['oversized_line'] samples=1

cases.title: Duplicate sequence is suppressed (one sample), a skipped sequence is counted but data kept
cases.expected: 1 sample for the duplicate; sequence_gaps==1 for the gap
cases.actual: duplicate samples=1 errors=[]; gap: gaps=1 samples=2

cases.title: Unknown sensor and boolean reading in a SAMPLE are rejected
cases.actual: {"unknown sensor": [["Unadvertised sensor"], 0], "boolean value": [["Invalid protocol message: ValidationError"], 0]}

cases.title: Historical event upload: valid assembly; missing chunk and wrong hash are not stored as events
cases.input: chunked upload of 2 events; drop first chunk of event 1; corrupt its SHA256
cases.expected: valid -> 2 events (expected 2); missing chunk -> fewer; bad hash -> fewer + error
cases.actual: valid=2 dropped_messages=1 missing_chunk=1 (errors ['Incomplete event upload']) bad_hash=1 (errors ['Event integrity failure']) sent twice=2 (DB de-duplicates, see QA-IOT-011)

cases.title: Invalid event window (end before detection) is refused
cases.actual: ValueError: Final event end must match the last sample and follow detection

cases.title: Backward timestamp in a device stream is rejected by quality validation (counted, not stored)
cases.actual: {"error": null, "accepted": 4, "rejected": 1, "events": 1, "measurements": 4}

cases.title: A protocol file that ends in the middle of an event upload is reported, no partial event stored
cases.actual: {"error": "ValueError: Truncated protocol stream/event", "accepted": 0, "rejected": 0, "events": 0, "measurements": 0}

cases.title: The same historical upload received in two separate connections stores each event once; replaying identical sequence numbers inside one stream is rejected loudly
cases.input: two sessions into one database; one stream with the upload twice
cases.expected: 2 events after the second connection; same-stream replay raises a protocol error
cases.actual: {"two_connections": {"error": null, "accepted": 156, "rejected": 0, "events": 2, "measurements": 278}, "same_stream_replay": {"error": "ValueError: خطأ بروتوكول الجهاز: HELLO is required for this device/session/source; HELLO is ", "accepted": 155, "rejected": 0, "events": 2, "measurements": 277}}

cases.title: Corrupted line in a protocol file ends with a clear protocol error
cases.actual: {"error": "ValueError: خطأ بروتوكول الجهاز: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)", "accepted": 0, "rejected": 0, "events": 0, "measurements": 0}

cases.title: Closed port raises an OSError (refused/timeout); LAN/hostname/IPv6/invalid port/timeout/reconnect configs are rejected; localhost accepted
cases.actual: closed port -> TimeoutError; {'LAN host': 'rejected', 'hostname': 'rejected', 'ipv6': 'rejected', 'port 0': 'rejected', 'port 70000': 'rejected', 'timeout 0': 'rejected', 'reconnects 9': 'rejected', 'localhost': 'accepted'}

cases.title: Garbage after the handshake over TCP raises a protocol error to the application
cases.actual: error=ValueError('خطأ بروتوكول الجهاز: Invalid protocol message: UnicodeDecodeError') samples=0 state=RECEIVING_DATA

cases.title: A server that accepts but never sends: timeout leads to CONNECTION_LOST (no hang)
cases.input: silent server, timeout 0.3 s, no reconnects
cases.actual: error=ConnectionError('TCP reconnect budget exhausted') state=CONNECTION_LOST after 0.31s

cases.title: Server closes the stream mid-data: samples already received are delivered, then CONNECTION_LOST
cases.expected: some samples, then ConnectionError, state CONNECTION_LOST
cases.actual: samples=5 error=ConnectionError('TCP reconnect budget exhausted') state=CONNECTION_LOST

cases.title: A 200 KB line without newline over TCP is rejected (bounded memory)
cases.actual: error=ValueError('خطأ بروتوكول الجهاز: oversized_line') pending_bytes=0

cases.title: Serial (fake port): valid stream decoded; the app never writes to the port; unplug and garbage are reported; empty/URL ports refused
cases.expected: samples decoded, writes==0, ConnectionError on unplug, ValueError on garbage, port closed
cases.actual: decoded=3 writes=0 unplug=ConnectionError('USB serial connection lost') garbage=ValueError('خطأ بروتوكول الجهاز: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)') empty=rejected url=rejected
cases.notes: Fake port only: no physical USB test (NOT TESTED on hardware).

cases.title: No handshake within the documented 10 s raises TimeoutError and state TIMEOUT
cases.actual: TimeoutError('لم تكتمل مصافحة الجهاز خلال 10 ثوانٍ')

cases.input: same device history, two live sessions into one database
cases.actual: first run historical=2; second run total historical=2

cases.title: Connection loss and reconnect: RECONNECTING shown, new boot isolated, no mixed sessions
